title: Platform · PostgreSQL cluster
description: Shared CloudNativePG cluster postgres-cluster (namespace postgres-db): primary + 2 replicas, every application's database.

panels.title: Instances up
panels.description: Instances whose exporter reaches PostgreSQL (3 expected: primary + 2 replicas).

panels.title: Primary
panels.description: The instance not in recovery. CloudNativePG fails over on its own; this changes when it does.

panels.title: Streaming replicas
panels.description: Replicas streaming WAL from the primary (2 expected).

panels.title: Max replication lag
panels.description: Seconds since the last replayed transaction, worst replica. Idle clusters read 0.

panels.title: Connections
panels.description: Backends on the primary as a share of max_connections.

panels.title: Cache hit ratio
panels.description: Shared-buffer hits on the primary. Below ~99% the working set no longer fits in shared_buffers.

targets.expr: sum(rate(cnpg_pg_stat_database_blks_hit{job="postgres"}[$__rate_interval]) and on(pod) (cnpg_pg_replication_in_recovery{job="postgres"} == 0)) / (sum(rate(cnpg_pg_stat_database_blks_hit{job="postgres"}[$__rate_interval]) and on(pod) (cnpg_pg_replication_in_recovery{job="postgres"} == 0)) + sum(rate(cnpg_pg_stat_database_blks_read{job="postgres"}[$__rate_interval]) and on(pod) (cnpg_pg_replication_in_recovery{job="postgres"} == 0)))

panels.title: Exporter errors
panels.description: 1 when the last metrics collection on any instance failed.

panels.title: Transactions/s by instance
panels.description: Replicas count read-only transactions served from them.

targets.expr: sum by (datname) (rate(cnpg_pg_stat_database_blks_hit{job="postgres"}[$__rate_interval]) and on(pod) (cnpg_pg_replication_in_recovery{job="postgres"} == 0)) / (sum by (datname) (rate(cnpg_pg_stat_database_blks_hit{job="postgres"}[$__rate_interval]) and on(pod) (cnpg_pg_replication_in_recovery{job="postgres"} == 0)) + sum by (datname) (rate(cnpg_pg_stat_database_blks_read{job="postgres"}[$__rate_interval]) and on(pod) (cnpg_pg_replication_in_recovery{job="postgres"} == 0)))

panels.title: Temp files written (primary)
panels.description: Sorts and hashes that spilled to disk: raise work_mem or fix the query.

panels.title: Deadlocks and conflicts
panels.description: Conflicts: queries on a replica cancelled because replay needed the rows they read.

panels.title: Backends by database and user (primary)
panels.description: Application connections arrive through PgBouncer (session mode), so these are pooled server connections.

panels.title: Longest open transaction
panels.description: Long transactions hold back vacuum and replication slots.

panels.title: Replay lag bytes (from primary)
panels.description: WAL the primary has sent that each replica has not replayed yet.

panels.title: pg_wal segments
panels.description: WAL segment files kept on each instance's volume (each 16 MiB); a stuck slot or archiver makes this grow.

panels.title: Checkpoints/min
panels.description: Requested checkpoints mean max_wal_size is too small for the write load.

panels.title: Transaction ID age (wraparound)
panels.description: Autovacuum freezes at 200M; trouble starts near 2B.
